ev.q: Among 541 campers and staff members, 31 cases of mumps were identified (attack rate: 5.7%)
Symptoms, illness duration, and complications (e.g., orchitis) did not differ substantially between vaccinated and unvaccinated patients.
Of the 31 mumps cases identified, 17 (55%) were in females.
